statement: Atomic CAS (Compare-and-Swap) mirrors biological enzymatic receptor binding: verify state at the microsecond boundary rather than incurring the global energetic penalty of a mutex fence.

summary: Heuristic Pruning & A* Search in Cognitive Latent Space
statement: Tree-of-Thought (ToT) reasoning is isomorphic to A* search over a state space: admissible heuristics prune unviable branches before combinatorial explosion occurs.
In distributed consensus as in collective human governance, progress requires strictly majoritarian quorum (N/2 + 1) to eliminate split-brain divergence under network or communicative severance.
